items.title: Apple sets iPhone launch event for Sept. 9, first under new CEO John Ternus
items.description: Analysts expect the company to launch new iPhones and Apple Watches at the event, including the company's first folding phone

items.title: Meta settles social media addiction case with California, other states for $16.7 billion
items.description: Meta and state attorneys general settled a federal trial centering on allegations that company misrepresented the extent of child-related mental health harms.

items.title: Mark Walter's TWG Global says there's 'no fraud' amid probe of insurers' disclosures
items.description: The empire of billionaire Los Angeles Dodgers owner Mark Walter has faced media scrutiny since he said he would sell his majority share of the LA Lakers.

items.title: Bill Gates warns ‘there is no plan’ for the ‘upheaval’ AI will cause
items.description: Bill Gates warned governments are not adequately preparing for how AI could displace workers, strain social systems and create global risks.

items.title: States sue to block Trump-backed USPS mail-ballot rule after Supreme Court setback
items.description: The rule in question would require election officials to give USPS voter information and use federally reviewed, uniquely barcoded ballot envelopes.

items.title: Fed, NASA and DOJ among victims of Chinese state-sponsored hacker group: Court documents
items.description: Hackers targeted networks "operated by hospitals, telecommunications providers, power companies, financial institutions, and defense contractors," a filing said.

items.title: Iran says the U.S. is standing in the way of Hormuz deal amid talks with Oman
items.description: Iran and Oman are approaching a deal to secure safe transit through the Strait of Hormuz and future administration of the vital economic artery.

items.title: The post-penny economy: How cash rounding and credit card surcharges are changing what you pay
items.description: More merchants are rounding change for cash purchases to the nearest nickel due to the end of penny production, or adding surcharges to credit card transactions.

items.title: I manage Dolly Parton’s Imagination Library in Cincinnati—the No. 1 lesson she taught me about success
items.description: Cincinnati literacy leader Kristy High reflects on Dolly Parton’s Imagination Library and the lesson Parton's philanthropy taught her about success.

items.title: Medical device maker Boston Scientific is being hit by a cyberattack. The shares are falling
items.description: The attack has disrupted the company's ability to ship products, and it's not clear when services will be restored.

items.title: We're buying the dip — again — in a retailer not getting credit for addressing weak sales
items.description: Wednesday's decline can be attributed to a downgrade at Jefferies, which we disagree with.

items.title: Lost in limbo: Where the Paramount merger delay leaves WBD, and what may come next
items.description: Paramount Skydance's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery is stalled due to an antitrust lawsuit, leaving WBD in limbo during a pivotal moment for media.

items.title: Fed’s preferred inflation gauge shows core prices rose 3.3% annually in July
items.description: The personal consumption expenditures price index was expected to rise 0.1% monthly and 3.6% on a 12-month basis, according to economists surveyed by Dow Jones.

items.title: Dollar and bond markets 'on edge' ahead of Jackson Hole as Bessent's market intervention piles pressure on Warsh
items.description: Strategists said investors were approaching Jackson Hole “on the back foot."

items.title: OpenAI’s Jalapeño AI chip brings new 'threat' to Nvidia margins as custom silicon gains ground
items.description: OpenAI’s Jalapeño chip beat Nvidia Blackwell systems on key inference-efficiency tests as custom AI silicon gains ground among major tech companies.

items.title: Canada unveils retaliatory tariffs on about $20 billion of U.S. goods
items.description: Canadian trade negotiators left the U.S. last week after failing to clinch a trade deal that would stop President Donald Trump's new tariffs from taking effect.

items.title: China's short-drama producers flood the market with cheap bets — and let audiences pick the winners
items.description: The short-drama model offers an alternative to traditional entertainment, but rising distribution costs and audience-retention challenges remain.

items.title: Amazon service Bezos once called 'artificial artificial intelligence' is shutting down
items.description: Mechanical Turk launched in 2005 as a way to farm out tasks that are easy for humans to complete but too challenging for computers.

items.title: Hyundai has grown more than any automaker in the U.S. — and it's not done yet
items.description: The South Korean automaker wants to keep going by ramping up production at a new $7.6 billion plant in Georgia to capture more sales and market share.

items.title: Mortgage rates hit highest level in 3 weeks, weakening demand further
items.description: Mortgage rates rose again last week causing demand for both refinances and purchase loans to drop. Rates climbed to their highest level in three weeks.
